exposure: lower head station on decision at previous cesarean delivery
lower newborn weight at previous cesarean delivery
larger cervical effacement on admission at delivery planned for TOLAC
cohort: Women with trials of labor after one cesarean (TOLAC) for non-progressive labor
finding: A predictive model incorporating previous successful VBAC, lower head station at previous cesarean delivery, lower newborn weight at previous cesarean, and larger cervical effacement on admission for planned TOLAC accurately predicted successful VBAC in 75.3% of cases.
